title: Moto Guzzi Stelvio 1200 (Urban Commuter)
description: Representing Aprilia's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Aprilia Moto Guzzi Stelvio 1200 (Urban Commuter) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 1200cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
